verdicts.reason: A is scattered. The headline sits in the top left, the subcopy floats off to the top right and the CTA drifts in the middle of the right column, so the reading order breaks. The Meridian logo is shrunk to an illegible speck and buried inside the blue circle in the bottom right, which wrecks brand presence. The circle is cut off at the bottom edge and no longer sits behind the suitcase, and the headline wraps 'far' onto its own line as an orphan. B keeps a sensible left text column (headline, subcopy, CTA) opposite the suitcase, but it still has clear flaws. The CTA is indented from the text's left edge, and the headline also orphans 'far'. The logo is tiny and jammed beside the sunglasses near the bottom, where it reads as an afterthought. The blue circle is cut off at the bottom and separated from the suitcase instead of backing it, and the gaps between blocks are uneven.
